about: Situational factors researched by session arena/22be6967 on 2026-10-15 between 10:05 and 10:30 UTC from HLTV (official CS news/team pages). 'risk_for' names the team the factor argues AGAINST (onboarding, stand-in, late notice, fatigue); 'neutral' factors are context only. A note is applied automatically to any open fixture of that team until 'relevant_until'. 'strength': strong = roster change within 60 days, stand-in, or late replacement; moderate = roster change 60-120 days old; weak = qualitative context (only strong/moderate count in the rule). Notes never change a probability: they only feed the leaderboard-strategy rule (situational upset) and are displayed with their links.

notes.summary: July international rebuild: Jimpphat and coach ash joined; kyxsan signed from Falcons on 8 July as IGL. About three months old by TWC, not a fresh onboarding event. Context only; no automatic penalty and no assumed fatigue effect.

notes.kind: roster change (player swap 28 days before TWC)
notes.summary: HObbit signed on 17 Sep 2026 and replaced slaxejezzz (benched). HLTV's team page showed HObbit at 27 days / 17 maps / 0.91 rating. Valve's 2026-10-05 standings still list the old five (with slaxejezzz), so Valve points describe a roster that no longer plays. Lost 0-2 to Legacy on day 1 (Dust2 11-13, Mirage 14-16).

Ninjas in Pyjamas replaced Virtus.pro at the Thunderpick World Championship; the swap was announced on 9 Oct 2026 after Virtus.pro withdrew (visa issue for AquaRS, health of F0R3VER). Lost 0-2 to Falcons on day 1 (Ancient 13-16 OT, Dust2 6-13).
arT is back in Legacy's lineup after missing ESL Pro League for health reasons (HLTV). Legacy won 2-0 on day 1 but needed round 24 on Dust2 and overtime on Mirage.
HLTV's TWC preview says FURIA's 'grueling schedule will also continue' at TWC. Weak, qualitative factor; FURIA beat BETBOOM 2-0 on day 1 (Ancient 13-10, Mirage 13-9; KSCERATO 1.72).

HLTV's match analytics for Elisa BreakOut Series 2 says Phantom plays with stand-in cej0t instead of Kunai. HLTV ranks Voca #59 and Phantom #88, and says Voca won 3 of its last 5 matches; the same page says Phantom is the bookmakers' favourite against Voca (no price shown in the static page).

Before TWC, 9z had group-stage exits at four straight events (EWC, BLAST Porto, FPG 3, EPL 24) per HLTV, then beat Aurora 2-0 (Inferno 13-11, Nuke 13-1; luchov 1.61 rating). HLTV's match list confirms 9z vs Falcons at 11:00 UTC on 15 Oct (Pinnacle lists 11:30).
